decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is core capital equipment backed by substantial in-house development and central to the firm's coding portfolio, so management persists with it and attributes weak results to the normal ramp-up and pandemic-related investment delays.

The CodeScan app was publicly launched as the expanded successor to PharmaScan and directly supports the announced digitalization and traceability direction, so the visible commitment and low running cost favor keeping it.
Inline code verification is central to the firm's serialization and end-to-end traceability strategy and complements its printers, so management continues to invest in it.
The layout design software was showcased on the home page and supports the firm's common-operation, one-stop solution promise across its systems, making withdrawal hard to justify.
